services.desc: Whether you’re celebrating love, family, or a major life moment, ADK Excursions is the perfect backdrop for your special event. Some moments deserve more than just a dinner reservation or a backyard gathering. Imagine celebrating life’s biggest milestones surrounded by the sparkling waters of Lake George, fresh mountain air, and your favorite people-all aboard a private boat designed for connection, laughter, and memory-making. At ADK Excursions, we specialize in turning ordinary events into extraordinary experiences.
